title: Horizontal Reel
description: Scroll down, travel sideways: vertical scrolling drives a horizontal strip of cards.
usage: The page’s scroll becomes the strip’s journey: a tall spacer, a sticky window, and a script that maps scroll fraction to sideways travel. In the wild it runs full-bleed sections; here it is boxed so the trick can be studied. Use it for the one gallery that deserves a journey. Do not use it for navigation.
a11y: The mapping is one-to-one with the scrollbar, so position is never a mystery, and every card is ordinary content in reading order. Under prefers-reduced-motion the strip becomes a plain horizontally scrollable row — the journey, democratized.
